Usage: fastapi run [OPTIONS] [path]                                            
                                                                                
 Run a FastAPI app in production mode. 🚀                                       
                                                                                
 This is equivalent to fastapi dev but with reload disabled and listening on    
 the 0.0.0.0 address.                                                           
                                                                                
 It automatically detects the Python module or package that needs to be         
 imported based on the file or directory path passed.                           
                                                                                
 If no path is passed, it tries with:                                           
                                                                                
 - main.py                                                                      
 - app.py                                                                       
 - api.py                                                                       
 - app/main.py                                                                  
 - app/app.py                                                                   
 - app/api.py                                                                   
                                                                                
 It also detects the directory that needs to be added to the PYTHONPATH to make 
 the app importable and adds it.                                                
                                                                                
 It detects the FastAPI app object to use. By default it looks in the module or 
 package for an object named:                                                   
                                                                                
 - app                                                                          
 - api                                                                          
                                                                                
 Otherwise, it uses the first FastAPI app found in the imported module or       
 package.                                                                       
                                                                                
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│   path      <path>  A path to a Python file or package directory (with       │
│                     __init__.py files) containing a FastAPI app. If not      │
│                     provided, a default set of paths will be tried.          │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --host                                          <str>   The host to serve    │
│                                                         on. For local        │
│                                                         development in       │
│                                                         localhost use        │
│                                                         127.0.0.1. To enable │
│                                                         public access, e.g.  │
│                                                         in a container, use  │
│                                                         all the IP addresses │
│                                                         available with       │
│                                                         0.0.0.0.             │
│                                                         [default: 0.0.0.0]   │
│ --port                                          <int>   The port to serve    │
│                                                         on. You would        │
│                                                         normally have a      │
│                                                         termination proxy on │
│                                                         top (another         │
│                                                         program) handling    │
│                                                         HTTPS on port 443    │
│                                                         and HTTP on port 80, │
│                                                         transferring the     │
│                                                         communication to     │
│                                                         your app.            │
│                                                         [env var: PORT]      │
│                                                         [default: 8000]      │
│ --reload                  --no-reload           <bool>  Enable auto-reload   │
│                                                         of the server when   │
│                                                         (code) files change. │
│                                                         This is resource     │
│                                                         intensive, use it    │
│                                                         only during          │
│                                                         development.         │
│                                                         [default: no-reload] │
│ --workers                                       <int>   Use multiple worker  │
│                                                         processes. Mutually  │
│                                                         exclusive with the   │
│                                                         --reload flag.       │
│ --root-path                                     <str>   The root path is     │
│                                                         used to tell your    │
│                                                         app that it is being │
│                                                         served to the        │
│                                                         outside world with   │
│                                                         some path prefix set │
│                                                         up in some           │
│                                                         termination proxy or │
│                                                         similar.             │
│ --app                                           <str>   The name of the      │
│                                                         variable that        │
│                                                         contains the FastAPI │
│                                                         app in the imported  │
│                                                         module or package.   │
│                                                         If not provided, it  │
│                                                         is detected          │
│                                                         automatically.       │
│ --entrypoint          -e                        <str>   The FastAPI app      │
│                                                         import string in the │
│                                                         format               │
│                                                         'some.importable_mo… │
│ --proxy-headers           --no-proxy-headers    <bool>  Enable/Disable       │
│                                                         X-Forwarded-Proto,   │
│                                                         X-Forwarded-For,     │
│                                                         X-Forwarded-Port to  │
│                                                         populate remote      │
│                                                         address info.        │
│                                                         [default:            │
│                                                         proxy-headers]       │
│ --forwarded-allow-i…                            <str>   Comma separated list │
│                                                         of IP Addresses to   │
│                                                         trust with proxy     │
│                                                         headers. The literal │
│                                                         '*' means trust      │
│                                                         everything.          │
│ --verbose             -v                        <bool>  Show detailed        │
│                                                         startup output and   │
│                                                         debug logs: how the  │
│                                                         FastAPI app was      │
│                                                         discovered,          │
│                                                         imported, and        │
│                                                         configured.          │
│ --help                -h                        <bool>  Show this message    │
│                                                         and exit.            │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
